purpose: Post-run visual analysis only: an auditable M5 rule chain (pivot -> sweep/reclaim -> confirmation -> entry -> exit) plus a centered-entry H1 anatomy panel with the outcome-bearing region explicitly disclosed.

contract_test.red_first: The forensic-context test first failed on unrecognized context arguments. Owner QA then exposed the missing current-H1 mapping and centered before/after semantics. The setup-chain contract finally failed on absent manifest fields before pivot, sweep/reclaim and confirmation markers were implemented.

case_builder.selection_rule: six frozen winner/loser strata retained; setup timestamps and prices are derived from the existing position context ledger

render_contract.entry_marker: exact deal timestamp/price mapped to the first containing M5 bar
render_contract.exit_marker: exact deal timestamp/price mapped to the containing M5 bar
render_contract.m5_setup_chain: pivot line plus distinct diamond sweep/reclaim marker, square confirmation marker and dashed connector into entry; every timestamp/price and predicate is written to the image manifest
render_contract.decision_state_cutoff: closed-bar metrics use only HTF bar_close <= entry; the blue-hatched partial overlay uses only source bars whose close <= entry
render_contract.partial_style: the full entry H1 candle is outcome-bearing; a hatched blue overlay preserves its exact as-of-entry partial state and the entry marker is placed on the same candle
render_contract.future_style: the entry H1 candle is anchored at 50% width; 24 later completed H1 candles are shown over a shaded region labeled POST-ENTRY OUTCOME

qa.visual_inspection: PASS. Every M5 panel now identifies the pivot, sweep/reclaim candle, confirmation candle, entry and exit with distinct shapes, direct labels and a connecting rule chain. Every H1 panel shows 24 bars on each side; the full center candle and right half are visibly outcome-bearing, while the blue hatch preserves the entry-time partial state.
qa.interpretation_boundary: Both panels are anatomy/outcome-bearing and may be used for lifecycle diagnosis. Only the blue-hatched partial, the pre-entry H1 candles and the reported closed-bar decision metrics represent information available at entry.
